Definition: Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hashub names more than one man, and each is named for faithful work rather than fame. One is a Merarite Levite chief in the Jerusalem lists, another repairs the wall by the tower of the furnaces, and another stands among those who seal the covenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God records the repairers and the sealers by name. Hashub's work was walls and covenants, and that is the kind of faithfulness God remembers.
RelatedEvents: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall; Israel Renews the Covenant
